notes: UI fix: in Settings → API Keys, the green '✓ Key works' confirmation no longer overlaps the key input box. The note's -8px top margin was tuned for the setup wizard's .setup-input (which has a 14px bottom margin); the Settings card uses bare password inputs with no bottom margin, so the note rode up onto the field. Scoped the two Settings notes (#settings-pexels-note, #settings-pixabay-note) to sit just below their input instead. No server.js change — a browser hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) is enough to pick this up.
